metadata.description: AI-powered cybersecurity, automation, and AI safety plugins by PEACH STUDIO. Research-driven tools for threat intelligence, security operations, and AI-augmented workflows.

plugins.name: ps-spec
plugins.description: Epic-driven development on OpenSpec: idea or PRD → EPICS.md with user stories → one OpenSpec change per epic (proposal, specs, design, tasks, test-plan) → git branch → code with observability → test plan with interactive debugging → feature doc → archive + merge. Four human checkpoints with an autonomous coding loop between them. Rules guard hook makes openspec config.yaml rules reach the model before every artifact write; secure-coding rule packs (OWASP 2025, MCP/AI/agent/RAG, per-language/framework) installed at init. Successor of idea-to-spec.

plugins.name: idea-to-spec
plugins.description: Superseded by ps-spec (same author; adds test plans, checkpoints, observability, secure-coding rules). Turn a loose idea for any tool or software into spec-driven artifacts: scope it, research options, write a PRD and epics, then codify each epic into validated OpenSpec changes (proposal → specs → design → tasks). Optional kickoff menu: Mermaid architecture, README + private git repo, prior-art research, tech-stack discussion.

plugins.name: business-profiler
plugins.description: Cybersecurity threat intelligence, attack surface assessment, and strategic sales targeting. 7 skills: full-profile, threat-profile, attack-surface, threat-actors, ot-ics-assessment, incident-lookup, sales-targeting.

plugins.name: email-verifier
plugins.description: Find and verify a work email without sending mail. Give it a name + company (it discovers the address) or an address to check. Cross-plane verification — SMTP RCPT fused with the Microsoft 365 Entra identity plane (GetFederationInformation + ROPC AADSTS differential) — confirms addresses even on accept-all tenants where plain SMTP is blind, with automatic sibling-domain fallback (mail domain vs login/UPN domain) and free keyless OSINT (Gravatar/GitHub/web). 1 skill: email-finder.

plugins.name: ps-vulnscan
plugins.description: Rule-driven security scanning: detect the project's stack, model its identities, roles, tenancy and authorization, download the matching secure-coding rule packs (OWASP Top 10 2025, per-language, per-framework, AI/agent/MCP/RAG) from claude-secure-coding-rules, then review the source against them and write one consolidated report with CVSS per finding. Leads with broken access control — IDOR/BOLA, missing function-level authz, cross-tenant leaks — then injection, SSRF, deserialization, session and auth flaws, secrets. Rule-driven grep and source review by default, optional semgrep OSS. One human checkpoint before anything is downloaded. No MCP server, no external scanner service, no exploitation. For the deeper hunt with PoCs and disclosure, use peach-vulnhunt.

plugins.name: peach-vulnhunt
plugins.description: Hunt for real, exploitable vulnerabilities and produce disclosure-ready reports. Two skills: vulnhunt (modern web apps — IDOR/BOLA, broken access control, privilege escalation, OWASP Top 10) and sysvulnhunt (C/C++ system code — memory corruption, RCE, privilege escalation). Scan locally (private) or via AWS Bedrock (higher recall), triage, build PoCs, report. Powered by the foil scanner.
